$description: SYNAPSE Chromatic — primitive (reference) tokens. Raw OKLCH ramps with no meaning. Build-time only; not emitted as CSS variables. Semantic tokens alias these.

neutral.$description: Elevation + text ramp — cool blue-graphite (v2.0.0, ADR-048). Hue 250 (a faint cobalt-cool graphite, NOT warm) at low chroma; chroma RISES with depth so the darkest surfaces read as cinematic blue-tinted shadow rather than dead grey (the complementary-contrast cool ground a saturated control room is lit against), and the L steps between surfaces are LARGE enough that elevation is legible without borders (borderless depth). The foundation is deliberately near-neutral so the semantic palette (agents, confidence, states) still carries the meaning — 'quiet foundation, loud meaning' — but the ground is now cool, not warm. Keyed by approximate lightness x1000.

tier.$description: Decision-tier ramp (I-8). Ordinal data on the Lightness axis: one cognition hue (H250, royal cobalt — the SYNAPSE signature, v2.0.0/ADR-048), strictly monotone-decreasing L from Tier 1 (reflexive, light cobalt) to Tier 4 (deep deliberation, deep cobalt). Chroma is kept MODEST so tier reads as ordered lightness ('quiet chrome'), rising slightly with depth so deeper deliberation reads richer.

confidence.$description: Confidence diverging scale (I-5). Continuous in OKLab; hue rises monotonically red->orange->green->teal. Stops anchored at the gate thresholds 0.00 / 0.70 / 0.80 / 1.00. v2.0.0 (ADR-048): the caution stop moved off gold to orange (H55) so the cool cobalt chrome owns the blue band — the diverging midpoint stays a warm caution signal and the hue order stays strictly increasing.

state.$description: Semantic state hues. v2.0.0 (ADR-048): warning + the confidence caution band moved off gold to ORANGE (H50/H55) — the cool cobalt foundation owns the blue band, and warm caution signals are the complementary pop that makes the blue read as dominant; warning stays staggered in lightness above danger (red) so the two warm states survive CVD. info is the one MEASURED blue (H248) and is unchanged. degraded (caution-family hue, now orange, chroma drained to ~1/3 of warning — the colour is literally running on reduced information, the VSUP philosophy as a state token; the chroma gap survives CVD because CVD compresses hue, not chroma) and synthetic (violet, >60 deg from every other state; never colour-only — always paired with a dashed ring + glyph per INV-CLR-011) are the v1.1.0 honesty states.
